commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' A free kick into the box, taken by Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
88' The substitution has been made. Adrien Lebeau (Brest) has replaced Mathias Pereira Lage.
87' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Le Havre.
84' Luka Elsner has decided to make a change. Simon Ebonog (Le Havre) replaces Oualid El Hajjam.
83' Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) has tested the patience of referee Pierre Gaillouste and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Loic Nego (Le Havre) will replace Yassine Kechta.
78' A pass across the box picks out an unmarked Jonas Martin (Brest) and he tries to place the ball towards the roof of the net, but it goes just over the bar.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) comes onto the pitch so that Emmanuel Sabbi can be given a rest.
76' Luka Elsner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) replacing Andre Ayew.
76' Martin Satriano (Brest) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Pierre Gaillouste had an easy-decision to make.
74' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
74' That will be all from Romain Del Castillo who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest).
72' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jonas Martin (Brest) was quite harsh and Pierre Gaillouste didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
70' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:8.
67' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
64' Eric Roy prepares a substitution. Hugo Magnetti is replaced by Jonas Martin (Brest).
64' Here's the change. Mahdi Camara leaves the pitch and Kamory Doumbia (Brest) comes on as a substitute.
62' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) is caught offside!
61' The move breaks down when Oualid El Hajjam (Le Havre) attempts an ambitious shot from distance that goes well wide of the right post.
58' Pierre Gaillouste blows for a foul after Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

56' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) attempts to threaten the goalkeeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. He produces a stunning blast which only flies inches over the crossbar. It could have been a beautiful goal!
55' Oualid El Hajjam (Le Havre) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
53' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Bizot keeps it out with an amazing save.
52' Pierre Gaillouste shows a yellow card to Romain Del Castillo (Brest) for his blatant foul.
51' A cross from a corner kick by Le Havre is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
50' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Now Le Havre have a corner.
48' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Pierre Gaillouste no option but to blow his whistle.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Luka Elsner gives a chance to Josue Casimir and Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) is off.
46' Referee Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' The game is interrupted as Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) is flagged offside.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Dangerous play by Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest). Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Arthur Desmas is alert and denies him.
40' Flag goes up against Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
38' The Brest players are exchanging some short passes.
34' 1 - 0 Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect strike that goes inside the top left corner.
30' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) hits a good looking first-time shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly over the bar.
26' 72:28 – the latest ball possession ratio.
23' That was close by Romain Del Castillo (Brest)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.

20' Martin Satriano (Brest) attempts to directly endanger the opponent's goal from the set piece just outside the box. He produces a good shot, directed into the roof of the net. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a good save.
19' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Bizot makes a comfortable save.
17' Martin Satriano (Brest) makes a strong challenge and Pierre Gaillouste blows for a foul.
14' Le Havre enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
9' Andre Ayew (Le Havre) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
8' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
7' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
6' Mahdi Camara (Brest) commits a rough challenge and Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle for a foul.
4' A corner kick by Le Havre is thwarted by the well prepared Marco Bizot (Brest).
4' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee signals a corner kick to Le Havre.
3' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Pierre Gaillouste has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Brest will take the kick-off.
Pierre Gaillouste got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
